caibao-fenxi 负责拿到数据后的五维度深度分析与陷阱识别。

skills.description: Enterprise business process management (BPM) suite covering the full process management lifecycle: process architecture planning (tiering / APQC PCF map / numbering), process mapping & modeling (swimlane / activity diagram / specification template), process analysis & diagnosis (time/cost/quality + ASME/EARS bottleneck identification), process optimization (EARS method + lean six-sigma linkage), business process reengineering (BPR per Hammer & Champy), process documentation & institutionalization, process execution & IT enablement (BPM system / OA workflow), process performance management (KPI design), process risk & internal control linkage, process change management (ADKAR / Kotter eight steps), and process management maturity assessment (BPMM / CMM).

覆盖企业流程管理全流程的BPM套件:流程架构规划、流程梳理建模、流程分析诊断、流程优化、流程再造BPR、流程制度与文件化、流程执行与IT化、流程绩效管理、流程风险与内控衔接、流程变革管理、流程管理成熟度评估。内置已核实的方法论出处(APQC PCF/EARS/BPR(Hammer & Champy)/ADKAR/Kotter八步/ASME/CMM/BPMM等,均注明为管理方法论)与准确性红线。

Disclaimer: 本套件辅助企业流程管理,不替代企业管理制度与决策程序。方法论引用仅供参考(APQC/EARS/BPR/ADKAR等均为管理方法论,非国家强制性标准);流程绩效分析基于用户提供数据,不虚构数据;建模示例为通用示范,需按企业实际流程填写。
